Knowledge Base
Hello Chase, I don’t have a background in coding, but I need to build a knowledge base system (possibly using RAG) for medical and legal content. What would be the best approach for me?
I’ve seen some of your videos, such as “Karpathy’s Obsidian RAG + Claude Code,” but I’m not sure if that’s the safest or most appropriate option given the sensitivity of these topics. I want to ensure the system can provide reliable and responsible responses.
Is there a way you could guide me through the process? Thank you very much.

May want to focus on validating whatever information goes into your knowledge system before you consider the rag. You can explore implementing a number of ways but you want to ensure the corpus of knowledge has been verified by a professional in the space ie the practitioner or research in the medical or legal fields. Unless you have tacit knowledge in those spaces ensure you get vetted information for your system. That secures the first level of safety
